messages:
alex chen: kicking off regional provisioning for ap-south-2 — focusing on GitOps/Helm pipeline + registry replication. Goal: smoke-ready GPU cluster and seeded images by EOD. Any blockers?
jia wong: thanks. can you paste the list of critical images we need pre-seeded? also we should sign them (cosign) before replication.
samir patel: FYI ap-south-2 has constrained egress during peak windows. if replication tries to hammer upstream dockerhub we'll get throttled. recommend using our pullthrough mirror + signed seed.
maria gonzalez: +1 to pullthrough. we can temporary bump cache TTL for the seeded tags. also consider using `--max-concurrency 6` on replication job to avoid bursting.
alex chen: list: 
- redwood/serve-runtime:prod-2026-03-01
- redwood/gpu-utils:1.4.2
- building/llm-base:quantized-8bit
We will cosign those. planning two-phase: 1) seed to mirror, 2) run repo-sync job (helm release) to deploy registry replication CRs.
infra-bot: checklist created: [ ] cosign signatures verified, [ ] mirror reachable from region, [ ] registry-replica CR applied, [ ] helm chart values validated, [ ] kube pull secrets present.
jia wong: cosign sigs done for serve-runtime and gpu-utils. still generating for llm-base, ETA ~30m.
samir patel: network note — the region egress goes through a shared NAT pool. cost estimate: initial replication ~1.2TB egress at $0.09/GB = ~$110. we should confirm budget owner ok.
maria gonzalez: we can reduce cost by brokering a direct cloud interconnect to the mirror region (if partner). but that adds ops time. For now request cost approval from finance.
alex chen: filing quick ticket to finance. cc @maria gonzalez.
eng-sre: helm tip — when applying registry-replica CRs use `helm upgrade --install registry-sync -f values-ap-south-2.yaml ./charts/registry-sync --wait --timeout 10m` to catch misconfigs early. also add `replica.backoffLimit=2` in values.
alex chen: deploy-bot kicked off helm deploy to staging.
deploy-bot: release/registry-sync v2026.03.17-staging deployed: STATUS=SUCCESS (3m 12s) - helm revision 7
jia wong: replication job started against mirror endpoint `mirror.ap-south-2.redwood-internal`. seeing steady progress, 200MB/min.
samir patel: small snag — imagepullsecrets missing in `gpu-nodepool` namespace -> some preflight pulls failing. adding secret now.
maria gonzalez: once secrets are added, run `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/registry-cache -n infra` to ensure caches rehydrate.
alex chen: added secret, restarted daemonset. tailing logs:
```
replicator-0: pulled redwood/serve-runtime:prod-2026-03-01 (size 780MB) checksum ok
replicator-0: pulled redwood/gpu-utils:1.4.2 (size 120MB) checksum ok
replicator-0: pulling building/llm-base: quant-8bit -> in progress
```
jia wong: llm-base completed and checksum matched. marking cosign verification in ticket.
eng-sre: validation checklist: 
- images present: yes
- checksums match: yes
- helm release healthy: yes
- node pools registered: yes
- kube-proxy egress rules checked: pending (samir)
samir patel: kube-proxy egress rules verified, added explicit deny for 0.0.0.0/0 except mirror endpoint.
alex chen: running load smoke on inference route (10 qps for 5m) to validate caching + latency. results: median latency 28ms token, p95 120ms, no OOMs.
maria gonzalez: cost runbook note — after seeding we should enable auto-prune on mirror for <30d dev tags to avoid storage blowup.
alex chen: handoff plan: tomorrow 09:00 UTC, infra handoff to platform-oncall. I'll add runbook steps to the ticket and link prometheus dashboards + access. anyone else want to join handoff?
jia wong: I'll join for the first 30m for cosign follow-ups.
samir patel: I'll join too for networking questions.
infra-bot: scheduled incident-handoff: 2026-03-18T09:00:00Z channel=#eng-oncall. checklist link: https://internal.redwood/ops/tickets/INC-4721
alex chen: thanks team. closing thread, reopening if we see regressions. :thumbsup:
